_note: MCP trust allowlist. Editing this file (add server, widen caps/tools, change pin) IS a re-authorization event: record it in git + audit. Unknown servers are DENY by default; nothing here falls back to allow.

workflowhub.authentication: api-key header X-Api-Key (env WORKFLOWHUB_API_KEY, never logged)
workflowhub.notes: Org-scoped; caller identity forwarded per request.

playwright.notes: Production logins use persistent profiles; tests MUST use disposable tmp profiles.

firecrawl.trust_level: medium (third-party; results are UNTRUSTED until verified)
firecrawl.notes: Keyless tier: no credential to leak. Tool RESULTS still go through verify-before-commit.

figma.notes: Disabled until needed; enabling requires explicit re-authorization.
